# String Utils Documentation

## Installation
```bash
npm install str-utils
```

## Quickstart
```javascript
const { camelCase } = require('str-utils');
console.log(camelCase('hello world'));
```

## Advanced API
```javascript
const { kebabCase } = require('str-utils');
console.log(kebabCase('fooBar'));
```
